name: planning
description: Use in MetaMask Mobile or MetaMask Extension when scope is ambiguous, the change is large, the work is security-sensitive or performance-sensitive, a contract or API is being changed, or the engineer asks for mms-planning or a plan. Ambiguous means the ask does not name the target, the action, and the expected result, or it leaves an open product or contract decision. Large means only a new product area, or a cross-system design whose scope is not decided. Security, performance, a contract or API change, a long diff, or several screens is not large by itself. Contract or API changes stop for a brief. Security and performance stop for agreement before the edit, even when fully specified. Recommend a spec only when the change is also large. Do not use it before every edit. When it applies, read the installed mms-* catalog and every matching skill before the edit, brief, or yes/no.
